sloka: अज्ञानादुपसम्पन्ना रज्जुरुद्बम्धिनी यथा ।रममाणस्त्वया सार्धम् मृत्युम् त्वा नाभिलक्षये ॥२-१२-८१॥
transliteration: ajñānādupasampannā rajjurudbamdhinī yathā ।ramamāṇastvayā sārdham mṛtyum tvā nābhilakṣaye ॥2-12-81॥

translations.english: While sporting with you, I did not realize you were death incarnate. Like a child handling a black cobra I caressed you.
